statement: H200 on-demand rental at Jarvislabs.ai is listed at $3.99 per GPU-hour in August 2026, with interruptible spot at $1.99 per GPU-hour.
why: A posted rental rate is a static price level for H200 capacity with no stated baseline or prior period in the document, so it records where rental pricing sits rather than which way it is moving.

impact.mechanism: Listed rental rates set the cost of renting H200 capacity from neocloud providers, which is the price overlay against which merchant-GPU purchase economics are compared.

evidence.excerpt: Jarvislabs.ai: On-demand '$3.99' per GPU-hour; Spot (interruptible) '$1.99' per GPU-hour; availability single GPU or 8-GPU nodes.

confidence.basis: Secondary aggregator blog; only the provider's own rate is first-party, and competitor figures were not separately fetched except one Nebius cross-check.

dispersion: Competitor H200 on-demand rates cited in the same post span roughly $3.82 (Vast.ai marketplace) to about $10.00-$10.60 at AWS/Azure/Oracle.
